product_overview: Achegue-se is a local services marketplace connecting residents with gastronomy, mobility, classifieds, professionals, and business management tools using a React + Supabase stack. The app focuses on location-based discovery, role-based access, and realtime mobility features.
core_goals: Provide fast, mobile-first discovery of local services (restaurants, drivers, classifieds, professionals).
Enable secure, role-based authentication and profile management for users, drivers, business owners, and admins.
Support mobility flows with realtime driver matching and tracking.
Allow local businesses and professionals to manage profiles, listings, and contacts.
Deliver a robust classifieds system with posting, browsing, and direct contact.
Ensure responsive performance, secure data access (Supabase), and maintainable frontend architecture (React + TypeScript).

features.name: Authentication & Profile
features.description: User sign-up, login, session management and profile retrieval with role assignment (user, admin, driver, business_owner).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with {email,name,password} -> Receive 201 Created and confirmation email sent -> POST /api/auth/confirm with confirmation_token -> Receive 200 Confirmed -> POST /api/auth/login with {email,password} -> Receive 200 with access_token and refresh_token -> GET /api/profile with Authorization: Bearer token -> Receive 200 with user profile and role
POST /api/auth/register with existing email -> Receive 409 Conflict with error message -> POST /api/auth/login with unconfirmed account -> Receive 403 Forbidden with 'email not confirmed' error

features.name: Gastronomy - Browse, Menu, Reviews, Favorites
features.description: Browse restaurants by location, view menus and reviews, and add restaurants to favorites.
user_flows: GET /api/gastronomy/restaurants?lat={lat}&lng={lng}&radius=5km -> Receive 200 with restaurant list -> GET /api/gastronomy/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/menu -> Receive 200 with menu items -> POST /api/gastronomy/favorites with {restaurant_id} and Authorization: Bearer token -> Receive 201 Favorite created -> GET /api/gastronomy/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/reviews -> Receive 200 with reviews
GET /api/gastronomy/restaurants?lat=invalid&lng=invalid -> Receive 400 Bad Request -> GET /api/gastronomy/restaurants?lat={lat}&lng={lng} (retry) -> Receive 200 with empty list when none found

features.name: Mobility - Request Ride / Delivery
features.description: Create ride/delivery requests, match with available drivers, and provide realtime driver tracking and status updates.
user_flows: POST /api/mobility/requests with {pickup:{lat,lng},destination:{lat,lng},type:'ride'} and Authorization: Bearer token -> Receive 201 Request created with request_id -> GET /api/mobility/requests/{request_id}/status with Authorization: Bearer token -> Receive 200 status 'searching' or 'matched' -> GET /api/mobility/requests/{request_id}/tracking with Authorization: Bearer token -> Receive 200 with driver location updates

POST /api/mobility/requests with missing pickup or destination -> Receive 400 Bad Request -> POST /api/mobility/requests with valid payload -> Receive 201 Request created -> GET /api/mobility/available-drivers?near={lat,lng} -> Receive 200 with empty array (no drivers) -> PUT /api/mobility/requests/{request_id}/cancel with Authorization: Bearer token -> Receive 200 Cancelled

features.name: Mobility - Driver Flow (Availability & Accept Ride)
features.description: Drivers set availability, receive ride assignments, accept/decline, and broadcast location for tracking.
user_flows: POST /api/mobility/driver/availability with {available:true} and Authorization: Bearer driver_token -> Receive 200 Availability updated -> GET /api/mobility/driver/assignments with Authorization: Bearer driver_token -> Receive 200 with pending assignment -> POST /api/mobility/assignments/{assignment_id}/accept with Authorization: Bearer driver_token -> Receive 200 Accepted -> POST /api/mobility/driver/location with {lat,lng} and Authorization: Bearer driver_token -> Receive 200 Location updated
POST /api/mobility/driver/availability with invalid token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> GET /api/mobility/driver/assignments with Authorization: Bearer invalid_token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Classifieds - Post & Browse Ads
features.description: Users can browse categorized local ads, post new ads, edit or remove their ads, and contact advertisers.
user_flows: GET /api/classifieds?category={category}&near={lat,lng} -> Receive 200 with listings -> GET /api/classifieds/{ad_id} -> Receive 200 ad details -> POST /api/classifieds/{ad_id}/contact with {message} and Authorization: Bearer token -> Receive 200 Contact message delivered

POST /api/classifieds with {title,category,description,price} without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> POST /api/classifieds with same payload and Authorization: Bearer token but missing required field -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors

features.name: Professionals - Discovery & Booking
features.description: Discover professionals by service, view profiles and services, and request/book appointments or jobs.
user_flows: GET /api/professionals?service={service}&near={lat,lng} -> Receive 200 list of professionals -> GET /api/professionals/{professional_id} -> Receive 200 profile and availability -> POST /api/professionals/{professional_id}/book with {timeslot} and Authorization: Bearer token -> Receive 201 Booking created -> GET /api/bookings/{booking_id} with Authorization: Bearer token -> Receive 200 booking details

POST /api/professionals/{professional_id}/book with a timeslot that is no longer available -> Receive 409 Conflict 'timeslot unavailable' -> GET /api/professionals/{professional_id}/availability -> Receive 200 updated availability

features.name: Business Module - Business Profile Management
features.description: Business owners can create and manage establishment profiles, operating hours, menus, and contact/location info.
user_flows: POST /api/business with {name,address,phone,owner_id} and Authorization: Bearer business_owner_token -> Receive 201 Business created -> PUT /api/business/{business_id} with {hours,location_coords,menu_id} and Authorization: Bearer business_owner_token -> Receive 200 Business updated -> GET /api/business/{business_id} -> Receive 200 Business public profile
PUT /api/business/{business_id} with Authorization: Bearer non_owner_token -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> GET /api/business/{business_id} -> Receive 200 Business public profile (read-only)

features.name: Realtime & Maps Integration
features.description: Provide map-based discovery and realtime updates for mobility using MapLibre and Supabase realtime features or WebSocket/SSE endpoints.
user_flows: GET /api/maps/tiles?bbox={bbox} -> Receive 200 Map tile metadata -> GET /api/gastronomy/restaurants?bbox={bbox} -> Receive 200 geojson restaurants -> OPEN WebSocket wss://api.acheguese/realtime?token={token}&channel=ride_updates -> Receive realtime driver location and status messages
OPEN WebSocket wss://api.acheguese/realtime?token=invalid -> Connection rejected or Receive 401 Unauthorized close -> GET /api/maps/tiles?bbox=invalid -> Receive 400 Bad Request

features.name: Admin - Moderation & Reports
features.description: Admin users can moderate content, view reports, and manage user roles.
user_flows: GET /api/admin/reports with Authorization: Bearer admin_token -> Receive 200 list of reports -> PUT /api/admin/reports/{report_id}/resolve with Authorization: Bearer admin_token -> Receive 200 Resolved -> PUT /api/users/{user_id}/role with {role:'driver'} and Authorization: Bearer admin_token -> Receive 200 Role updated

GET /api/admin/reports with Authorization: Bearer non_admin_token -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> PUT /api/users/{user_id}/role with Authorization: Bearer admin_token but invalid role -> Receive 400 Bad Request

code_summary.description: Achegue-se is a local services marketplace platform focused on gastronomy, mobility, classifieds, and professional services. It is a modular web app built with React 18, TypeScript, and Supabase as the backend.
